## Checklist

<!-- See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full guidelines. -->

- [ ] One resource per pull request.
- [ ] The entry is in the most fitting section, in alphabetical order within it.
- [ ] Format is `[Name](link) – Description.` with the description starting uppercase and ending in a period.
- [ ] The description is short and factual – no marketing language, no emoji.
- [ ] The link works and points directly at the resource, not at a search or index page.
- [ ] The resource is not already on the list.
- [ ] The Table of Contents is updated if a section was added.
- [ ] The resource uses a published release of BLIT386 (1.0.0 or later).
